WITH LatestSnapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS latest_snapshot
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
HouseholdSizes AS (
    SELECT 
        hl.region,
        d.head_of_household_id,
        COUNT(d.id) AS household_size
    FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON d.id = hl.id
    JOIN LatestSnapshot ls ON TRUE
    WHERE d.person_status = 'صالح'
      AND d.death_date IS NULL
      AND d.person_type = 'Saudi'
      AND d.head_of_household_id IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
          WHERE hp.id = d.id 
            AND hp.snapshot = ls.latest_snapshot
            AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE
      )
    GROUP BY hl.region, d.head_of_household_id
)
SELECT 
    region,
    ROUND(AVG(household_size), 2) AS avg_household_size
FROM HouseholdSizes
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY avg_household_size DESC LIMIT 20000
